script.text: After the duel, Yuma learned his new friend had some sort of affinity with these new Number Cards.
This Number Card represents a piece of my memory. But just a small piece. For my memory to truly return, I must collect all 100 Number Cards.
We had a deal, so here's Bronk's deck back.
Thank you for keeping your word.
You’re a good duelist. I’ll see ya around.
Hey, perhaps we can do this again some time. Only forget the decks. Let's just duel for good ol' fashioned fun. That's the best way to feel the flow!
